data.narrative:
Kvertus is a Growth-stage defense and security company founded by Yaroslav Filimonov and Andrii Znaichenko, having raised approximately $130M to date. The Defense & Security sector comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. However, the narrow peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage matches at similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median approach.

Given data constraints, stage-progression analysis provides the primary valuation signal. Using the $130M total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $156M. This method is applicable and grounded in observed stage transitions within the frontier defense ecosystem.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $133M to $179M, centered at $156M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression median, appropriate for a company at this maturity with incomplete comparable data. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and margin profile relative to the broader sector, which remain unmeasured against available public and private benchmarks. Any binding valuation would require deeper diligence into unit economics and customer concentration.
